en.text: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

zhSimplified.text: 当作王，作王，作王，作王的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 當作王，作王，作王，作王的時候，

en.text: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

zhSimplified.text: 他们都攻打王、王、王、王，和王；就是。

zhTraditional.text: 他們都攻打王、王、王、王，和王；就是。

en.text: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

zhSimplified.text: 这五王都在会合；就是。

zhTraditional.text: 這五王都在會合；就是。

en.text: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

zhSimplified.text: 他们已经事奉十二年，到十三年就背叛了。

zhTraditional.text: 他們已經事奉十二年，到十三年就背叛了。

en.text: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

zhSimplified.text: 十四年，和同盟的王都来在，杀败了人，在杀败了人，在杀败了人，

zhTraditional.text: 十四年，和同盟的王都來在，殺敗了人，在殺敗了人，在殺敗了人，

en.text: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

zhSimplified.text: 在人的杀败了人，一直杀到靠近旷野的。

zhTraditional.text: 在人的殺敗了人，一直殺到靠近曠野的。

en.text: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

zhSimplified.text: 他们回到，就是，杀败了全地的人，以及住在的人。

zhTraditional.text: 他們回到，就是，殺敗了全地的人，以及住在的人。

en.text: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

zhSimplified.text: 于是王、王、王、王，和王（就是）都出来，在摆阵，与他们交战，

zhTraditional.text: 於是王、王、王、王，和王（就是）都出來，在擺陣，與他們交戰，

en.text: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

zhSimplified.text: 就是与王、王、王、王交战；乃是四王与五王交战。

zhTraditional.text: 就是與王、王、王、王交戰；乃是四王與五王交戰。

en.text: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

zhSimplified.text: 有许多石漆坑。王和王逃跑，有掉在坑里的，其余的人都往山上逃跑。

zhTraditional.text: 有許多石漆坑。王和王逃跑，有掉在坑裏的，其餘的人都往山上逃跑。

en.text: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

zhSimplified.text: 四王就把和所有的财物，并一切的粮食都掳掠去了；

zhTraditional.text: 四王就把和所有的財物，並一切的糧食都擄掠去了；

en.text: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

zhSimplified.text: 又把的侄儿和的财物掳掠去了。当时正住在。

zhTraditional.text: 又把的姪兒和的財物擄掠去了。當時正住在。

en.text: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

zhSimplified.text: 有一个逃出来的人告诉人；正住在人的橡树那里。和并都是弟兄，曾与联盟。

zhTraditional.text: 有一個逃出來的人告訴人；正住在人的橡樹那裏。和並都是弟兄，曾與聯盟。

en.text: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

zhSimplified.text: 听见他侄儿被掳去，就率领他家里生养的精练壮丁三百一十八人，直追到，

zhTraditional.text: 聽見他姪兒被擄去，就率領他家裏生養的精練壯丁三百一十八人，直追到，

en.text: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

zhSimplified.text: 便在夜间，自己同仆人分队杀败敌人，又追到左边的，

zhTraditional.text: 便在夜間，自己同僕人分隊殺敗敵人，又追到左邊的，

en.text: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

zhSimplified.text: 将被掳掠的一切财物夺回来，连他侄儿和他的财物，以及妇女、人民也都夺回来。

zhTraditional.text: 將被擄掠的一切財物奪回來，連他姪兒和他的財物，以及婦女、人民也都奪回來。

en.text: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

zhSimplified.text: 杀败和与他同盟的王回来的时候，王出来，在迎接他；就是。

zhTraditional.text: 殺敗和與他同盟的王回來的時候，王出來，在迎接他；就是。

en.text: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

zhSimplified.text: 又有王带着饼和酒出来迎接；他是至高 神的祭司。

zhTraditional.text: 又有王帶着餅和酒出來迎接；他是至高上帝的祭司。

en.text: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他为祝福，说：「愿天地的主、至高的 神赐福与！

zhTraditional.text: 他為祝福，說：「願天地的主、至高的上帝賜福與！

en.text: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” gave him a tenth of all.

zhSimplified.text: 至高的 神把敌人交在你手里，是应当称颂的！」就把所得的拿出十分之一来，给。

zhTraditional.text: 至高的上帝把敵人交在你手裏，是應當稱頌的！」就把所得的拿出十分之一來，給。

en.text: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

zhSimplified.text: 王对说：「你把人口给我，财物你自己拿去吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 王對說：「你把人口給我，財物你自己拿去吧！」

en.text: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

zhSimplified.text: 对王说：「我已经向天地的主—至高的 神耶和华起誓：

zhTraditional.text: 對王說：「我已經向天地的主－至高的上帝耶和華起誓：

en.text: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

zhSimplified.text: 凡是你的东西，就是一根线、一根鞋带，我都不拿，免得你说：『我使富足！』

zhTraditional.text: 凡是你的東西，就是一根線、一根鞋帶，我都不拿，免得你說：『我使富足！』

en.text: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

zhSimplified.text: 只有仆人所吃的，并与我同行的、、所应得的分，可以任凭他们拿去。」

zhTraditional.text: 只有僕人所吃的，並與我同行的、、所應得的分，可以任憑他們拿去。」
